newsitem.title: USA: Survey finds Internet services growing fast.
newsitem.headline: Survey finds Internet services growing fast.

text.p: American Business Information Inc said Internet Service businesses were the fastest growing in number in 1996.
Based on information derived from its database, the company found only 24 Internet service firms at the start of 1996 but 2,298 at the end of the year -- a growth rate of 9,475 percent.
Health and fitness program consultants represented the largest decline in numbers for the year to 2,662 at the end of the year from 3,317, American Business said.

Other firms that are growing in numbers range from the high-tech, such as computer networking, pager services and cellular telephone services, to bagel shops and tattoo parlors, American Business said.

Businesses that are declining in number include retail typewriter sales and services, comic book stores, baseball sports cards and memorabilia stores, coffee and tea shops and antenna systems, the company's survey said.

American Business Information said its database is compiled from 4,800 Yellow Page directories, business white pages and other public information. The database is verified with additional telephone calls, the company said.
By comparing the number of businesses listed from year to year, growth and decline percentages are calculated, American Business Information said.
